name: LAN Multiplayer
author: PyGameMaker
description: School LAN multiplayer game programming. Tier A: a shared-variable blackboard, custom messages, and player identity (host_game / join_game / set_shared_var / send_network_message), plus the Réseau lifecycle events. v1's spectator position sync (set_network_mode + --net-host/--net-client) is still available. Authoritative host, TCP, no NAT traversal. See docs/MULTIPLAYER_LAN_V2_PLAN.md.
